headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | July 22, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Tech stocks boosted US stock rebound, Nasdaq up over 1%, chip index surged, Micron's market cap back above $1 trillion; Yen broke below 163; Precious metals rose, silver up over 4%. Trump: Iran wants talks but US 'not interested', will 'soon' strike Natanz nuclear facility, warned Houthis not to block Red Sea. US Trade Representative hinted at new tariff policies soon. US Treasury Secretary Bessent claimed US will soon control 80% of global computing power. Yen hit 40-year low, USD/JPY broke above 163, increasing risk of Japanese intervention. China Securities Regulatory Commission held symposiums with listed companies on Monday and Tuesday to seek opinions on promoting stable and healthy capital market development. CSRC said it will actively respond to market concerns and enhance market stability. Quantitative private funds faced collective performance declines, reigniting 'quantitative selling' controversy. 113 private funds participated in IPO subscription.

headlines.title: 广州：加快推动生物医药企业挂牌上市
headlines.summary: 广州印发《金融支持广州市生物医药产业发展若干措施》的通知。加快推动生物医药企业挂牌上市。聚焦生物医药企业的成长特点和融资需求，按行业赛道、企业规模、上市阶段等维度，建立分类、分阶段的企业上市培育机制，做到突出重点、梯度发展、分层培育。建立生物医药企业挂牌上市后备企业库，加强与上海证券交易所南方中心、深圳证券交易所广州服务基地、全国股转系统北京证券交易所华南服务基地、广东股权交易中心等协调联动，提供专业咨询、挂牌上市辅导、函件协助等“一站式”服务。合理引导生物医药企业在广东股权交易中心、全国中小企业股份转让系统挂牌，推动符合条件的企业在境内外资本市场上市。

headlines.title_en: Guangzhou: Accelerate the listing of biomedical companies
headlines.summary_en: Guangzhou issued notice on 'Several Measures for Financial Support of Biomedical Industry Development in Guangzhou'. Accelerated promotion of biomedical companies listing. Based on growth traits and financing needs, establish a classified and phased listing cultivation mechanism by industry track, company size, and listing stage. Build a reserve pool for biomedical companies planning to list, strengthen coordination with Shanghai Stock Exchange Southern Center, Shenzhen Stock Exchange Guangzhou Service Base, NEEQ Beijing Stock Exchange South China Service Base, and Guangdong Equity Trading Center to provide one-stop services including professional consultation, listing guidance, and document assistance. Guide biomedical companies to list on Guangdong Equity Trading Center and NEEQ, and push qualified companies to list on domestic and overseas capital markets.

headlines.title: A股创新药板块走强，药康生物涨超13%，莱美药业涨超8%，益诺思、哈三联、博瑞医药、华兰股份、众生药业等个股跟涨
headlines.summary: A股创新药板块走强，药康生物涨超13%，莱美药业涨超8%，益诺思、哈三联、博瑞医药、华兰股份、众生药业等个股跟涨。消息面上，美国总统特朗普当地时间7月21日在社交媒体发文表示，自2026年8月1日起，所有进口到美国的仿制药将在未来两年内继续适用零关税。两年期满后，相关产品将被征收100%的关税，期限为一年；此后，关税将进一步提高至200%。

headlines.title_en: A-share innovative drug sector strengthens; Yaokang Bio up over 13%, Lummy Pharma up over 8%; Innost, Harbin Sanlian, BrightGene, Hualan Biological, ZhongSheng Pharma among gainers
headlines.summary_en: A-share innovative drug sector strengthened, Yocon Biotechnology up over 13%, Lummy Pharmaceutical up over 8%, Yinuosi, Hasen, Bolton Pharma, Hualan Shares, Zhongsheng Pharmaceutical and others followed. News: US President Trump posted on social media on July 21 that from August 1, 2026, all generic drugs imported to the US will continue to have zero tariff for the next two years. After two years, related products will face 100% tariffs for one year, then tariffs will increase to 200%.

headlines.title: 港股异动丨黄金股集体爆发，赤峰涨9.5%、灵宝涨近8%，金价重返4120美元关口
headlines.summary: 港股黄金股盘初拉升上扬，赤峰黄金涨9.5%领衔，灵宝黄金、中国白银集团涨近8%，紫金黄金国际涨6%，中国黄金国际涨4.5%，招金矿业、紫金矿业涨4.4%，山东黄金、潼关黄金、珠峰黄金跟涨。 消息上，7月21日纽约尾盘现货黄金已涨1.76%报4078美元，22日早盘更连续突破4090、4100、4110、4120美元关口。中信期货认为，逢低买盘推动金价阶段性反弹，4000美元关口支撑显现，央行购金需求依然强劲为金价提供底部支撑。此前中金公司也指出，黄金股是金价的"放大器"，在反弹时上涨更多，具备盈利弹性与成长属性。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock movers: Gold stocks surge; Chifeng up 9.5%, Lingbao up nearly 8%; gold price returns to $4,120
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong-listed gold stocks rose at open, Chifeng Jilong Gold up 9.5% leading, Lingbao Gold, China Silver Group up nearly 8%, Zijin Gold International up 6%, China Gold International up 4.5%, Zhaojin Mining, Zijin Mining up 4.4%, Shandong Gold, Tongguan Gold, Everest Gold followed. News: July 21 NY spot gold up 1.76% at $4,078, July 22 morning broke through $4,090, $4,100, $4,110, $4,120. CITIC Futures believes dip-buying drove gold's rebound, $4,000 support appeared, central bank gold demand remains strong. CICC noted gold stocks are 'amplifiers' of gold prices, rising more in rebounds with earnings flexibility and growth attributes.

headlines.title: 中国商务部：牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉已达到规定数量的80%
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公告，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于7月21日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家规定数量的80%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: China's Ministry of Commerce: Beef imports from Brazil under safeguard measures have reached 80% of the stipulated quota
headlines.summary_en: China Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imports from Brazil under safeguard measures reached 80% of the specified quota for that country, as per MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025, on July 21. Per the announcement, when imports reach 100% of the quota, a 55% tariff will be added on top of current applicable tariffs from the third day onward.

headlines.title: 商务部：将对巴西进口牛肉加征55%关税
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月22日讯，商务部发布2026年度牛肉保障措施执行提示信息（六）。牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于2026年7月21日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家（地区）规定数量的80%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: To impose 55% tariff on beef imports from Brazil
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 22: MOFCOM issued executive reminder No. 6 for 2026 beef safeguard measures. Beef imports from Brazil under safeguard measures reached 80% of the specified quota for that country (region) under MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025 on July 21, 2026. Per Announcement No. 87, a 55% tariff will be added on top of current tariffs from the third day after imports reach 100%.

headlines.title: Shanghai beats GDP estimates with 5.6% growth – but two-speed recovery persists
headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...
headlines.title_zh: 上海GDP增长5.6%超预期，但双速复苏态势延续
headlines.summary_zh:
上海市上半年经济同比增长5.6%，受高科技制造业和出口强劲增长推动，表现优于预期，但消费支出疲软凸显复苏不均衡。
根据市统计局周一发布的数据，该增速超过全国4.7%的增长水平

headlines.title: 外资机构密集发声看好中国股市
headlines.summary: 近日，花旗集团、渣打银行、瑞银等多家国际知名投行密集更新A股市场研报，纷纷上调市场评级与盈利预期，看多中国股市的共识持续强化。 看多中国资产的同时，外资入市布局也在加快。截至2026年二季度末，北向资金持股数量合计超过1078亿股，环比增加超过40亿股。按照二季度末收盘价计算，北向资金持股市值超过3万亿元，达到3.13万亿元，创互联互通机制开通以来季度新高。从持仓结构来看，外资偏好硬科技资产的特征明显。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Foreign institutions are speaking frequently with a bullish view on Chinese equities
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Citigroup, Standard Chartered, UBS and other major international investment banks intensively updated A-share market research reports, raising market ratings and earnings forecasts, strengthening consensus on bullish outlook for Chinese stocks. While bullish on Chinese assets, foreign capital inflows accelerated. As of end-Q2 2026, northbound holdings exceeded 107.8 billion shares, up over 4 billion shares quarter-on-quarter. At end-Q2 closing prices, northbound market value exceeded RMB 3 trillion, reaching RMB 3.13 trillion, a quarterly record since connect mechanism launch. By holding structure, foreign funds favored hard-tech assets. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.summary_en: A-share semiconductor sector rallied, Torrence up over 17%, Dawei Shares up over 8%, NAURA Technology, Joulwatt, Fuman Micro, Yuanjie Technology, Zhenbao Technology, Goke Micro and others followed. News: TSMC reportedly plans to raise prices for advanced and mature process nodes from 2027, with base increases up to 10%. Meanwhile, Yuanjie Technology announced expected H1 net profit of RMB 600-650 million, up 1197%-1305% YoY.

headlines.title: 摩根士丹利：预计宁德时代将发强劲季报 近期股价上涨受资金轮动推动
headlines.summary: 摩根士丹利周二发布的报告称，宁德时代周五将发布二季度业绩，有望超过公司指引以及该行的预估（分别为净利润220亿元与230亿元人民币），对未来业绩的指引也将强劲。近期接触的许多投资者表示，希望从交易过于拥挤的AI板块适度分散配置，转向基本面扎实、此前表现相对落后的优质公司。宁德时代明年增长前景预计依然强劲。柴油车电动化、储能超级周期的多重驱动力，以及钠离子电池产品周期启动，都将继续支撑公司增长。维持对宁德时代“增持”评级。

headlines.title_en: Morgan Stanley: Expects CATL to report a strong quarterly result; recent share price gains driven by fund rotation
headlines.summary_en: Morgan Stanley report Tuesday said CATL will release Q2 results Friday, likely exceeding guidance and the bank's estimates (net profit RMB 22 billion and RMB 23 billion respectively), with strong future guidance. Many investors recently contacted expressed desire to diversify from crowded AI trades to quality companies with solid fundamentals and lagging performance. CATL's growth outlook for next year remains strong. Diesel vehicle electrification, energy storage super-cycle, and sodium-ion battery product cycle launch will continue supporting growth. Maintain 'overweight' rating on CATL.

headlines.title: China Merchants Securities drops South Korea ETF as Seoul stock volatility spills over
headlines.summary:
A leading Chinese brokerage house has ended market making for the mainland’s only South Korea-focused exchange-traded fund (ETF), as Beijing steps up efforts to stabilise its capital markets and protect retail investors amid volatility in its East Asian neighbour’s stock market.
Shenzhen-headquartered China Merchants Securities withdrew as a liquidity provider for the Huatai-PineBridge China-Korea Semiconductor ETF barely a month after assuming the role on June 17, according to Shanghai Stock...
headlines.title_zh: 招商证券因首尔股市波动蔓延暂停韩国ETF交易
headlines.summary_zh: 一家领先的中国券商已停止为内地唯一一只专注于韩国的交易所交易基金（ETF）提供做市服务，因在北京正加大力度稳定资本市场并保护散户投资者之际，其东亚邻国股市波动加剧。总部位于深圳的招商证券退出了流动性提供。

headlines.title: A股异动丨油价继续上涨，油气股集体走强，通源石油涨超6%，中曼石油涨近6%
headlines.summary: A股市场油气股集体上涨，其中，科力股份涨超10%，通源石油涨超6%，中曼石油涨近6%，潜能恒信涨超4%，首华燃气涨超3%，中国海油、和顺石油涨超2%。 消息面上，美伊军事冲突进入第10日，胡塞武装宣布对沙特实施海上封锁，红海曼德海峡通行量两周内骤降34%。国际油价继续上涨，其中，WTI原油期货涨至85.75美元/桶，创6月12日以来新高；布伦特原油期货涨至92.66美元/桶，创6月11日以来新高。

headlines.title_en: A-share market movers: Oil prices continue to rise; oil stocks strengthen across the board; Tongyuan Petroleum up over 6%, Zhongman Petroleum up nearly 6%
headlines.summary_en: A-share oil and gas stocks rose collectively, Keli Shares up over 10%, Tongyuan Petroleum up over 6%, Zhongman Petroleum up nearly 6%, Potent Oil up over 4%, Shouhua Gas up over 3%, CNOOC, Heshun Petroleum up over 2%. News: US-Iran military conflict entered day 10, Houthis announced maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia, Red Sea Mandeb Strait traffic dropped 34% in two weeks. International oil prices continued rising, WTI crude futures rose to $85.75/barrel, highest since June 12; Brent crude rose to $92.66/barrel, highest since June 11.
